description: This file defines the InProcessSiloHandle class, which manages the lifecycle of an Orleans silos that run within the same process and AppDomain. It includes methods for creating, stopping, disposing, and logging related to the in-process silo handle.

classes.name: InProcessSiloHandle
classes.description: Represents and manages an Orleans silo instance running within the same process. Provides lifecycle management including creation, stopping, and disposal.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates and initializes an in-process silo handle asynchronously with optional post-configuration.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync
methods.description: Stops the silo asynchronously, with an option for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync
methods.description: Stops the silo asynchronously using a CancellationToken.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the silo handle resources synchronously.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the silo handle resources.
